title: Test, Benchmark and Prove It's Right
brief: An agent nobody measured is an agent nobody should trust.
Build a 30-question benchmark on the agent, with ground-truth SQL for each:
10 smoke     — questions that must always work.
12 coverage  — one per topic the agent claims to answer.
8 traps     — at least one per planted flaw in the data.
Two of the traps must be questions where the CORRECT behaviour is to ask for
clarification rather than answer. 'What was our return last year?' is one: gross,
net and money-weighted are all defensible, so answering with one of them silently
Run it, record the score, fix the top 3 failures, re-run, report before and after.

checks.name: 30 or more benchmark questions
checks.hint: Ten smoke, twelve coverage, eight traps.

checks.name: Every benchmark question has a ground-truth answer
checks.hint: A benchmark without an expected answer records a run, not a result.
